description: Realign a drifted listing into a logical order under one stated principle, moving items and rewording nothing. Use on a catalog, index, table of contents, enum, or menu whose order has gone arbitrary, or when the user says "reorder this" or "put this in a sensible order". The principle is stated before the first move. Content edits belong to debloat or unslop.
